description: This Java source file defines the EntityListIterator class, which implements a cursor-based iterator for handling database query results within the Apache OFBiz framework. It provides methods for navigating, retrieving, and managing result sets of GenericValue entities, supporting operations like moving to first, last, next, previous, and partial result lists, with resource management and exception handling.

classes.name: EntityListIterator
classes.description: A cursor-based iterator for traversing database query results of GenericValue entities, supporting navigation, partial retrieval, and resource management within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: setDelegator
methods.description: Sets the delegator used for entity operations.

methods.description: Moves the cursor to just after the last result.

methods.name: beforeFirst
methods.description: Moves the cursor to just before the first result.

methods.name: last
methods.description: Moves the cursor to the last result.

methods.name: first
methods.description: Moves the cursor to the first result.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the iterator and releases resources.

methods.name: currentGenericValue
methods.description: Retrieves the current row as a GenericValue object.

methods.name: currentIndex
methods.description: Returns the current cursor position index.

methods.name: absolute
methods.description: Moves the cursor to an absolute row position.

methods.name: relative
methods.description: Moves the cursor relative to its current position.

methods.description: Checks if there is a next result.

methods.name: hasPrevious
methods.description: Checks if there is a previous result.
